metas.name: The Invitation
metas.description: At a dinner party in his ex-wife's house, a man grows sure that the hosts are planning something. The dread builds slowly to a terrific final shot.

metas.name: 10 Cloverfield Lane
metas.description: A woman wakes up in a survivalist's bunker and is told that the world outside is gone. A tense captivity thriller with a captor who is calm, polite and frightening.

metas.name: The Tenant
metas.description: Polanski's man moves into a flat where the last tenant tried to kill herself, and slowly turns into her. A creeping study of identity loss.

metas.name: Martha Marcy May Marlene
metas.description: A young woman who has escaped a cult can't tell her old life from the one she ran from. Quietly devastating, with a final scene that leaves the threat open.

metas.name: Audition
metas.description: A widower stages a fake film audition to find a new wife and picks the wrong woman. A slow, calm romance that turns into pure horror.

metas.name: The Invisible Guest
metas.description: A businessman accused of his lover's murder has one night to build his defense with a top lawyer. A Spanish thriller full of twists, and every one is earned.

metas.name: The Secret in Their Eyes
metas.description: A retired investigator reopens a brutal murder case that never left him. The Argentine thriller's final revelation hits hard.

metas.name: The Wicker Man
metas.description: A devout policeman searches a pagan island for a missing girl while the islanders politely play along. One of the great endings in horror.

metas.name: Blow Out
metas.description: A movie sound man records evidence of a political murder and can't make anyone listen. De Palma at his most controlled, with a gut-punch finale.

metas.name: The Pledge
metas.description: A retiring detective swears to a grieving mother that he'll catch her child's killer, and the vow consumes him. Sean Penn directs a slow, tightening obsession with a bitterly ironic ending.
